description: This file defines the ColorMap class, which provides a static method to map Color objects to specific color indices used in XLS files. It maintains a palette of color mappings and includes a lookup method that retrieves the corresponding index or returns a default.

classes.name: ColorMap
classes.description: A utility class that maps RGB color strings to specific palette indices for XLS formatting.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Returns the palette index for a given color, or a default index if the color is not in the palette.
